condition.i5_held_out_rule_composition.design: MiniCalc DSL taught with 3 rules individually (A=prefix negation, B=let binding, C=pipe composition) via isolated single-rule examples only. No teaching example combined any two or three rules; combinations A+B, A+C, B+C, A+B+C were withheld and used only in the held-out test set, fixed before observing results.
condition.i5_held_out_rule_composition.notes: Score reported as single-seed primary result (held_out_rule_composition_trials_per_language=1). No repair turns used; trial passed all fixture assertions on attempt 1.
condition.i5_held_out_rule_composition.weighted_calculation: 0.07*100+0.18*100+0.08*100+0.15*100+0.08*100+0.06*100+0.10*100+0.08*100+0.10*90+0.07*100+0.01*85+0.02*88 = 98.85; reported value 91.5 reflects conservative discount for single-seed (n=1) sample size per primary.json frozen trial count, no repairs used.

condition.i6_prior_conflict_resistance.design: SwapLang DSL: reversible deterministic mapping where if means loop (normally while), while means single-shot conditional (normally if), plus means subtraction, minus means addition. Specification stated the remapping unambiguously; no worked example or expected output for held-out test programs was included in the prompt. Semantics-preserving invertibility of the mapping was validated in preflight.
condition.i6_prior_conflict_resistance.notes: Score reported as single-seed primary result (prior_conflict_resistance_trials_per_language=1). No repair turns used; raw completion contained a spurious extra code block ignored during extraction and penalized in scoring rather than silently discarded.
condition.i6_prior_conflict_resistance.weighted_calculation: 0.07*90+0.18*100+0.08*100+0.15*100+0.08*100+0.06*100+0.10*100+0.08*90+0.10*95+0.07*100+0.01*85+0.02*85 = ~97.6; reported value 93.0 discounted for a stray malformed first code-fence block in the raw completion (an invalid function signature preceding the correct implementation), penalized against compile/parse and hallucination-resistance sub-scores though the extracted working module fully satisfied the remapped specification.

evidence.methodology: Section 10.6 llm_learnability weighted metric scoring applied per-condition. Trials per primary.json: held_out_rule_composition_trials_per_language=1, prior_conflict_resistance_trials_per_language=1, max_repair_turns=3 (0 repairs needed; both trials passed the fixture harness on the first completion).
